facts.business: RattanIndia Enterprises Limited operates in digital commerce, electric mobility (through Revolt Intellicorp), advanced drone technologies, and consumer brands (through Neobrands Limited).

capacity_or_capex.item: Revolt Intellicorp Manesar facility - 50,000th electric motorcycle rolled out

guidance_or_targets.statement: Government's vision of making India a global drone manufacturing hub by 2030

auditor.name: Rajesh Kumar (Whole-Time Director) and Ashok Kumar Sharma (CFO) certified; Independent Auditor's Report referenced but firm name not stated in excerpts

key_risks: Geopolitical uncertainty and evolving global supply chains
Persistent inflationary pressures in advanced economies
Dependence on imported defence technologies and vulnerabilities in global supply chains
Impairment indicators in respect of subsidiary (Revolt Intellicorp) requiring recoverability assessment
Inventory existence and valuation risks at fulfilment centres managed by third-party marketplace platforms
Significant management judgement and estimates for inventory loss provisions and net realisable value
facts.related_party_note: Arrangement with RattanIndia Power Limited (RPL) for commercial development on 421 acres surplus land at Amravati Thermal Power Plant, approved by shareholders, subject to MIDC and lender approvals. Refer note 38(XI) for related party balances.
